notes.title: DJAS Games Presents: Get Ready for Tretrais!
notes.content:
[p]Tretrais Game is Shaped with Players!
Hello dear players![/p][p]As DJAS Games, we’re thrilled to soon introduce you to our new game, [i]Tretrais[/i], which we’ve been meticulously working on for a long time! This isn’t just a game—it’s an experience we’ll develop and grow together.[/p][p]🎯 It’s not complete without you!
When the game launches, we want to address any bugs, balance issues, or improvements needed with you, our valued players. To do this, we’ll actively use our official [url="https://discord.gg/DRr8UJxhnz"]Discord server[/url]. On Discord, you can directly communicate with us, report bugs, and share your suggestions.[/p][p]💡 Let’s build the future together!
The future of [i]Tretrais[/i] is in your hands. We won’t just fix bugs. With your ideas, we’ll develop:[/p][list][*][p]Brand-new weapon systems,[/p][/*][*][p]Creative traps,[/p][/*][*][p]Powerful and tactical turrets,[/p][/*][*][p]And upgrade systems to maintain game balance.[/p][/*][/list][p]Every player’s input is valuable to us. Even the smallest feedback can spark major changes![/p][p]🧠 We invite everyone who wants to be part of the game’s development process to our [url="https://discord.gg/DRr8UJxhnz" style="button"]Discord server[/url]. When the game launches, you won’t just be a player—you’ll be one of the creators of this world.[/p][p]Stay tuned, big things are coming soon! 🚀[/p][p]Thank you,
The DJAS Games Team[/p]
